law_text: Schema law for memory/corpus/symbol_dictionary.jsonl, codified stego-canon-pipeline pass e 2026-09-27 (JSONL cannot carry comments, so this row is the schema of record and is a meta-row carrying symbol, law_text, the routing field, and open_risks by design (open_risks landed pass i 2026-09-27)): every entry carries symbol, added_at, added_by, interpretation, source_pointer, canon_hits, mint_shape, external_referent, siblings. canon_hits are sense-gated: only canon-sense lines count; homonym lines are lookup surface, never canon_hits. Homonym noise requires sense tags: a symbol whose inbox hits mix senses carries a homonym_note and a line-read sense check in its law. Version note: ExploitGym predates mint_shape/siblings (schema v1, retroactively inbox-anchored); Jacob Coxon is schema v2; permadeath is the first sense-gated entry (schema v3).
routing: Routing order for interpretation lookup: exact-name match fires first; then siblings-array match fires with the parent entry; then sense-tag canon_hits; a siblings hit cites the parent entry's id (its symbol) in the lookup receipt.
open_risks: sense-collision at the exact-name leg: routing is sense-blind at lookup; a same-name-different-sense arrival (roguelike-sense permadeath, watch/inbox/GAMEDIG_roguelike-runs-BalatroHades-vein_20260926.md:177) would exact-name match and resolve into the canon-sense entry with no arrival-side sense check anywhere on the path; the fix needs the pre-registered falsifier build first (sense field on hits, BURN_stego-canon-pipeline_20260927_h.md), so the routing text stays unamended until that build lands
